points.description: States the first steps: detecting/identifying the candidate distribution from the data (analysing the data's distribution) and then fitting the model (fitting the distribution to the data / estimating its parameters).
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only one of the two steps (identifying the distribution OR fitting the model) is stated precisely.

points.description: States checking the goodness of fit of the fitted model using the chi-square test, and then analysing/interpreting the results.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if goodness-of-fit checking is stated but the chi-square test is not named, or the chi-square test is named but analysis of results is missing.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the sequence: detect the distribution, fit the model, check goodness of fit by the chi-square test, and analyse the results. Give part marks only if clearly more than half of a point is stated precisely. Vague answers (e.g. "plot the data" or "use statistics") or a wrong test named as the goodness-of-fit check earn nothing for that point.
